# hpe_morpheus_certificate (Resource)

Manages a Morpheus Certificate resource.




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cert_file` (String, Sensitive) The contents of the certificate file.
- `key_file` (String, Sensitive) The contents of the key file.
- `name` (String) The name of the certificate.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the certificate.
- `domain_name` (String) The domain name this certificate is tied to.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the certificate is enabled.
- `id` (Number) The ID of the certificate.
